name: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me,  lad ? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
narrative.objectives: Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...

Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
narrative.requestItemsText: Yes? Do you have something for me?
